Tech Armor Beiorg is one of the Six Armors who rules over the land of Beiorg, after it killed the ruler of the land in the battle against a certain mechanical puppet.
__TOC__

sections.title: History
sections.content:
Before the encounter with Summoner, Beiorg was one of the armors that Reis made, as the fourth in the installation. After the destruction of Reis' world, Beiorg got sucked into the portal and arrived in Ishgria. It met the Demon Lord of the land, who was very fascinated to the Armor, to the extent that he gave the Armor the same name as his own. Several times later, Reis arrived at Ishgria and built a robot to help the Armor evolve. When the robot finally found the Armor, they engaged in a fierce battle. The robot was forced to accept its defeat by the Armor's hand and exploded, killing the Demon Lord of Beiorg. The Armor, now known as Tech Armor Beiorg, then continued to protect the land.

When Beiorg meets the Summoner, it recognized the them as a threat to the land, and thus "must be eliminated". It attacked soon after the Summoner arrives at Windmill Garden, but then flees after player beat it once because Seria, Lugina, and Paris caught up. The next encounter happens in the Ancient City Maldoor, where the Summoner beats it again before it flees one last time to Beiorg Castle, where the Summoner must defeat it in order to advance to the next region.

sections.title: Trivia
sections.content:
- In unit lore it is said that if it was still online it could become the most strongest weapon in Ishgria due to the powerful demons and its ability to analyze foes
- Beiorg is the one of two final bosses of the Ishgria maps (excluding Owen in Zamburg) to not have the ability to use Empty Seal.
- Beiorg in the bonus dungeon does have the ability to use Empty Seal. This because the "Beiorg" in that dungeon is actually the shadow of the Demon Lord of Beiorg, and is different with Tech Armor Beiorg.
